scientific_answer: Whole-recipe finite-window comparisons are available. Maximum sustainable capacity, production SLO, quality equivalence and temporal stability remain unresolved.
configuration_scope: Four named whole layout/backend/KV recipes; speculation flags differ within paired recipes.

metric_contract.acceptance_length: 1 + sum(accepted token deltas)/sum(draft step deltas); null for NoSpec
metric_contract.window_output: successful output tokens from turns finishing within 360 seconds divided by 360 and 8 GPUs
metric_contract.cohort_elapsed_output: measured-cohort output divided by first scheduled-to-last terminal elapsed time through drain, separate from window throughput
metric_contract.latency: successful-turn nearest-rank completion p50/p95/p99; p95 requires 20 turns and p99 requires 100; turns within conversations are correlated
metric_contract.stream_timing: first/last nonempty chunks may contain multiple tokens and are not individual-token clocks
metric_contract.counter_samples: actual native before/after scrape brackets near 365 seconds, not exact 360-second counters

limits: split is INCONCLUSIVE_CACHE_STATE_CONFOUNDED and diagnostic only
A/W2/.02 native coverage inconclusive, not observed overload
D/4.05 unmeasured after lower failed drain
D/.05 coordinator read-only review overlap unquantified and descriptive only
turns within conversations correlated; sparse percentile cutoffs retained
Responses storage equivalence, startup equivalence and full-container byte identity not claimed
optional final A drift omitted; temporal stability unresolved

Nominal 64K/256K labels conceal broad prepared prompt ranges: W1 45075-117842 and W2 219003-445038 tokens. Per-turn ranges and exact cross-arm matches are retained; these are not fixed-length workloads.
